name: Poly Pantheon
source:
You are Demon Prince Lothorn, and though you'd much rather be playing your znez at home some idiot angels decided to kidnap you in order to stop the war. Where your more interested in playing video games their more interested in playing with you. Is escape from these touchy feely angels possible or will you submit to their whims and desires?

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/poly-pantheon-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演恶魔王子Lothorn。虽然他更想在家玩znez，几个愚蠢的天使却为了阻止战争而把他绑架了。你更感兴趣的是玩电子游戏，而他们更感兴趣的是“玩”你。你能逃离这些动手动脚的天使吗？还是会顺从他们的心愿与欲望？

[摘自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/poly-pantheon-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]
